Container.Name: docker-safeguard
Container.Overview: Backs up any Docker app's appdata and full configuration (image, ports, env vars, mounts, the unRAID template itself) into one archive, and restores it elsewhere so the app comes back up instantly runnable with the same data and options. Save backups to any unRAID share or an external USB/NVMe/HDD.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Docker Safeguard web interface

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Needed to inspect, create, and start containers

Config.Name: User Shares
Config.Description: Read appdata and write backups to any share

Config.Name: Unassigned Disks
Config.Description: Backup to/restore from a USB/NVMe/HDD mounted via Unassigned Devices

Config.Name: Unassigned Remotes
Config.Description: Backup to/restore from a mounted network remote

Config.Name: unRAID Docker Templates
Config.Description: Read/write unRAID's own per-container template XML for high-fidelity backup and restore

Config.Name: App Config
Config.Description: Docker Safeguard's own settings, job history, and login
